integrity: Direct finite checks are corroborative, not an unrestricted proof. The proof uses simultaneously diagonalizable idempotents and a central shear. Individual-retraction rank/conjugacy counts are acknowledged as known; the claim is about commuting tuples and maximal families.
scientific_limitations: Applies to free nilpotent Lie algebras of class two over finite fields, n>=2. Does not count arbitrary or nonfree Lie endomorphisms; possible equivalent general-semigroup reformulations remain an originality risk.
title: Clique polynomials and maximal retraction families in free class-two Lie algebras
